draft_inquiry.subject: Clarification of the Hy-Bor 104HP / T800 / G83 reference property basis
draft_inquiry.body: We are reviewing the2025-10-28 Hy-Bor104HP/T800/G83 sheet and would appreciate any existing public technical report or corrected sheet that resolves the following. The description names a250F cure, while the cure-temperature row gives290F/143C: which cure cycle applies to the reported mechanical and density results? For the0degree ASTM D6641 compression andD3039 tension results, what are the complete ply schedule, coupon dimensions, test conditioning/temperature, lot/sample count and uncertainty? Does the ASTM D792 density1.799g/cm3 refer to the same cured material/state as those coupons, and what are the separate boron/carbon fractions within the listed62percent total fiber volume? Please distinguish the open-hole specimen layup from the0degree data. Are same-state transverse modulus, shear properties and compression data available for any explicitly identified multidirectional working layup? Finally, are all values representative only, or is there a separately documented statistical/design-allowable basis? We are treating the existing values as references, not as a working-wall qualification, and are not requesting new tests or a purchase.

acceptance_of_future_evidence: Any reply or newly located source must be archived with origin/version/bytes, retain exact architecture/state and per-property test basis, and undergo normal independent verification before workingY or physical claims. A source clarification is not itself a validated point. No proprietary-data upload, credentials, external message, spending or testing is requested by the current internal handoff.
